profile.primaryRole: Senior technology and GRC executive driving digital transformation, risk management, and IT strategy at financial institutions
profile.summary: Amit is a 30+ year technology executive with deep hands-on expertise across commercial banking, capital markets, and enterprise IT, having led GRC framework implementations, M&A integrations, and large-scale digital transformation programs at US financial institutions including IDB Bank, Bank Leumi USA, CIT Group, and CLS Bank. He bridges business and technology leadership, with particular strength in third-party risk, credit risk platforms, API-driven integration, and regulatory compliance. His consulting-style delivery model across multiple banks signals a senior advisor-practitioner who operates at the executive or near-C-suite level.
